text: Every great cup starts with a conversation.
Meet Brew. Your tea concierge, on WhatsApp.
Got a tea question? From the perfect masala chai to the right strength, just ask.
Order in one message. Add your details in a tap, then pay by UPI or link, right in the chat.
Come back anytime. Brew remembers your details, your usual, and how you like your tea.
Then it's packed fresh and delivered straight to your door, with updates along the way.
Meet Brew. Your chai experience just got easier, and better.
